The service is still as kind and polite as ever.
The waiting time is long.

I have been a patient of Dr. Kondo's care since he was working in Yokohama. I am drawn to his kind personality, his thorough explanations of treatment plans, and his unwavering support and care for pet owners. Despite the distance, I continue to bring my pets to WAF.

Two years ago, I rescued a two-month-old kitten with a severe infection and a fractured knee. Dr. Kondo surgically repaired the leg, which we thought might need amputation.

During her two-week hospital stay, the nurses showered her with affection, and she grew into a very friendly and affectionate cat. She is now happily living with my two other cats. Thank you so much. I look forward to your continued support.


Postscript: One of my other cats was diagnosed with nasal lymphoma and a lung tumor. After consulting with Dr. Kondo, we started immunotherapy along with chemotherapy. After four treatments, the lung tumor is almost completely gone. We are continuing with the Maruyama vaccine to prevent recurrence, and she is full of energy, gaining weight and becoming very healthy. She is an older cat, but I look forward to your continued support.

We received excellent care from this veterinary clinic until our beloved cat passed away.

She needed IV fluids daily, and the clinic patiently and thoroughly instructed us on how to manage her condition at home, which was incredibly reassuring.

They even saw our cat as an emergency case the day before she died and suggested we bring her back the next day, but she passed away before then.

They noticed we hadn't contacted them and called us, and even sent flowers the next day. Their thoughtfulness was a huge comfort.

This is a truly trustworthy animal hospital that stays by your side until the very end.

My cat accidentally swallowed a string, so I looked up nearby hospitals and found this one. Apparently, string ingestion can be serious, so they suggested tests. Fortunately, there were no problems, and they carefully explained the treatment plan in case of worsening, which put my mind at ease.

I read in reviews that walk-in appointments cost 5000 yen, but they said there's no charge now if you come during regular hours.

I was worried for a while, but they treated my cat with such care and attention that she's now back to her normal, healthy self. Thank you so much.

I've used this clinic several times, and while the reception staff are friendly, they sometimes forget to give me receipts and other documents, so I have to go back another day to pick them up.

The prices are also on the high side. Even though I went at night during business hours, they were fully booked and said it would cost an additional 5,000 yen to see me.

I waited quite a while, but they examined me and even gave me an IV drip, which I had previously received at another clinic for the same symptoms, which ended up costing me tens of thousands of yen. When I got home exhausted, I realized the IV needle was still taped into my pet's paw. I called them in a panic, but it went to voicemail.

I was afraid my pet might bite the needle, so I slept with them that day. When I called the next morning, they asked me to bring them in. I don't have a car and I was afraid to let my pet walk with the needle still in, so I wanted a nurse to come and remove it, but they couldn't do it. I will never go there again.

Our beloved cats have been receiving care at this clinic ever since it opened. No matter what, the doctor and everyone at the clinic are always kind and attentive. Even our timid cats seem to trust the clinic enough to relax during examinations, making it a very reassuring place to be. We look forward to continuing to use your services!
Perhaps due to a lack of experience or study, the diagnosis is not good and I don't understand why it is so highly rated.

They make you wait and don't even see emergency patients! 
Profit-oriented

Even though it was within business hours, when I mentioned it was my first visit, I was told there were no doctors available. I wanted to be seen as an emergency case, so this was a disappointing response.

Even with an appointment, I'm always kept waiting.
